notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence: mostly Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted; paraphrased) plus Dept of Marine keeper lists. Fjeldsted's 1904 appointment matched by column position in OCR table (cite 10); the 1904 report row was too garbled to use. Keeper dates for Halldorson and Grimolfson are not given. Date of the second tower is disputed (1926/1929/1930). The Scott/$380 contract text is quoted by Lighthouse Friends apparently from the 1898-99 Marine report, which is not in the corpus. Storm-night story is a daughter's recollection (via LF), no vessel or date. Parks Canada DFHD pages return only a stub, so register text was read via HistoricPlaces.ca and Heritage Guide. Record's Fl W 5s and 5 m focal height not verified; range 17 nm from register text. Access to the towers is not stated by any source; 'Fisheries and Oceans Canada' in the record vs 'Canadian Coast Guard' in MHS. A third lighthouse near the marina (MHS) is not covered. Checker 2026-10-27: Fjeldsted's 6 May 1904 appointment verified by column order in the 1912-13 Manitoba table (fifth station, fifth date). Halldorson/Grimolfson years are Lighthouse Friends' keeper list. Storm-night account has no date.
